## Summary

Full Cycle 3 Stage 4 frozen-inventory record and category-cohort review across all 1,129 eligible TraitRecord YAML files (1,130 total minus 1 DO_NOT_WORK excluded physiology/spore_germination.yaml, traitmech:000083) in 10 category cohorts at commit 8ee71cf99e270d60a2e08b550728f0cabdd6ce96 (395 eligible METPO: records and 734 eligible traitmech:NNNNNN records). All 1,129 eligible records pass strict schema, identifier, causal-graph, snippet, UniProt protein_examples, and METPO proposal checks. Seventeen concrete minor open findings (F-C3S4-DEF-SRC-001..017: 1 missing record-level definition_source evidence entry on photoorganoheterotrophic.yaml and 16 unquoted record-level definition_source evidence entries across ecology, metabolism, morphology, and physiology where verified verbatim quotes from the exact same definition_source already exist on the record's own causal_graphs or on a parent/sibling TraitRecord) are recorded with explicit remediation actions for Cycle 3 Stage 5 (resolve_review_findings), alongside the five carried-forward deferred cohort-level source-limited or upstream-blocked findings.

## Scope And Provenance

Complete frozen-inventory record and category-cohort review of all 1,129 eligible TraitRecord YAML files across all 10 category directories (ecology: 40, environment: 122, genomics: 387, metabolism: 180, morphology: 129, observation: 20, other: 32, physiology: 204 eligible, quantitative_property: 7, upper: 8) using .claude/skills/review-yaml-record/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/review-yaml-category/SKILL.md.

Selection: All 1,129 eligible TraitRecord files in data/traits/ at frozen commit 8ee71cf99e270d60a2e08b550728f0cabdd6ce96; no sampling.
Coverage: full; 1129 reviewed / 1129 in the declared population.
Source: git_commit at Git base 8ee71cf99e270d60a2e08b550728f0cabdd6ce96.

## Findings

### F-C3S4-DEF-SRC-001: photoorganoheterotrophic.yaml omits definition_source DOI:10.1016/B978-012373944-5.00083-3 from record-level evidence despite quoting it on causal_graphs[0].edges[0].evidence[0] on the same record (photoorganoheterotrophic_trait -&gt; light)

minor / open / confirmed; issue key: photoorganoheterotrophic-definition-source-evidence.

data/traits/physiology/photoorganoheterotrophic.yaml (METPO:1000659) declares definition_source: DOI:10.1016/B978-012373944-5.00083-3 and omits DOI:10.1016/B978-012373944-5.00083-3 from record-level evidence[] (MISSING_DEFINITION_SOURCE_EVIDENCE), even though causal_graphs[0].edges[0].evidence[0] on the same record (photoorganoheterotrophic_trait -&gt; light) already carries the verified verbatim snippet 'use of light' from DOI:10.1016/B978-012373944-5.00083-3.

minor / open / confirmed; issue key: oxidase-activity-definition-source-snippet.

data/traits/physiology/oxidase_activity.yaml (traitmech:000076) declares definition_source: DOI:10.3390/microorganisms10050926 and cites DOI:10.3390/microorganisms10050926 in record-level evidence[0] with notes only and no snippet (UNQUOTED_DEFINITION_SOURCE), even though causal_graphs[0].edges[9].evidence[0] on the same record (family_a_cytochrome_c_oxidase -&gt; cytochrome_c_oxidase) already carries the verified verbatim snippet 'Cytochrome c oxidases of the heme–copper oxygen reductase family A' from DOI:10.3390/microorganisms10050926.

### F-COHORT-CAUSAL-GRAPHS-SOURCE-LIMITED-005: 388 eligible records lack causal_graphs due to source-limited mechanism literature (366) or non-mechanistic vocabulary scope (22)

minor / deferred / confirmed; issue key: cohort-causal-graphs-source-limited.

Across 1,129 eligible records, 741 carry connected causal_graphs (up from 738 in Cycle 2 after +3 Cycle 3 Stage 2 graphs: coagulase_positive.yaml, indole_test_positive.yaml, pyrazinamidase_activity.yaml) while 388 do not: 366 records are source-limited in currently cited abstracts/local corpora without verifiable multi-step molecular pathways, and 22 records belong to non-mechanistic vocabulary/metadata cohorts (upper: 8, observation: 1, quantitative_property: 7, morphology supporting vocabulary: 6).

Disposition: Deferred under open GitHub issue #1982: 22 records are non-mechanistic supporting/upper/quantitative vocabulary by design, and 366 records require full-text literature beyond currently available open abstracts to construct non-speculative causal_graphs.

  topic: Missing or unquoted record-level evidence entry for definition_source on
    17 records with verified intra-record or parent/sibling verbatim quotes
  outcome: concern

    starch_degradation, three_hydroxypropionate_bicycle, ethanol_fermentation, lactic_acid_fermentation,
    mixed_acid_fermentation, fermentative_hydrogen_production, calvin_benson_bassham_cycle,
    dissimilatory_manganese_reduction, dissimilatory_nitrate_reduction_to_ammonium),
    morphology (4: peritrichous, amphitrichous, lophotrichous, monotrichous), and
    physiology (2: photoorganoheterotrophic, oxidase_activity) omit their primary

findings:
- finding_id: F-C3S4-DEF-SRC-001
  issue_key: photoorganoheterotrophic-definition-source-evidence
  category: evidence
  severity: minor
  status: open
  certainty: confirmed
  title: photoorganoheterotrophic.yaml omits definition_source DOI:10.1016/B978-012373944-5.00083-3
    from record-level evidence despite quoting it on causal_graphs[0].edges[0].evidence[0]
    on the same record (photoorganoheterotrophic_trait -> light)
  description: 'data/traits/physiology/photoorganoheterotrophic.yaml (METPO:1000659)
    declares definition_source: DOI:10.1016/B978-012373944-5.00083-3 and omits DOI:10.1016/B978-012373944-5.00083-3
    from record-level evidence[] (MISSING_DEFINITION_SOURCE_EVIDENCE), even though
    causal_graphs[0].edges[0].evidence[0] on the same record (photoorganoheterotrophic_trait
    -> light) already carries the verified verbatim snippet ''use of light'' from
    DOI:10.1016/B978-012373944-5.00083-3.'
  target_ids:
  - METPO:1000659
  field_paths:
  - definition_source
  - evidence
  - causal_graphs[0].edges[0].evidence[0]
  evidence_ids:
  - ev-corpus-records
  - ev-snippet-audit
  - ev-c3s4-def-src-001
  owner_paths:
  - repository: CultureBotAI/TraitMech
    path: data/traits/physiology/photoorganoheterotrophic.yaml
    role: maintained TraitRecord YAML
- finding_id: F-C3S4-DEF-SRC-002
  issue_key: oxidase-activity-definition-source-snippet
  category: evidence
  severity: minor
  status: open
  certainty: confirmed
  title: oxidase_activity.yaml cites definition_source DOI:10.3390/microorganisms10050926
    in record-level evidence without a verbatim snippet despite verified quote in
    causal_graphs[0].edges[9].evidence[0] on the same record (family_a_cytochrome_c_oxidase
    -> cytochrome_c_oxidase)

    definition_source: DOI:10.3390/microorganisms10050926 and cites DOI:10.3390/microorganisms10050926
    in record-level evidence[0] with notes only and no snippet (UNQUOTED_DEFINITION_SOURCE),
    even though causal_graphs[0].edges[9].evidence[0] on the same record (family_a_cytochrome_c_oxidase
    -> cytochrome_c_oxidase) already carries the verified verbatim snippet ''Cytochrome
    c oxidases of the heme–copper oxygen reductase family A'' from DOI:10.3390/microorganisms10050926.'
  target_ids:
